instruction: Explain this in simple words a 12-year-old would understand, in 2 or 3 sentences.
text: Inflation is the rate at which the general level of prices for goods and services rises, eroding purchasing power. Central banks raise interest rates to cool demand when inflation runs above target.

instruction: Summarise this as 3 short bullet points.
text: The new leave policy starts on 1 April. Everyone gets 25 days a year plus bank holidays, up from 22. Up to 5 unused days can be carried into the next year, but they must be used by 30 June. Requests for more than 10 days in a row need two months' notice.

instruction: Rewrite this as a formal letter to the housing society, polite but firm.
